hook.rumour: Three Arcane University survey-scholars walked into the Great Forest west of Weye with a crate of empty welkynd cages, and only their pack-mule came back.
hook.notice: ARCANE UNIVERSITY & WEYNON PRIORY: Reward offered at Weye and Wawnet Inn for word of the missing Ayleid survey party in the Great Forest.

stages.objective: Speak with the bridge-wardens in Weye about the Arcane University survey team's route
Search the scholars' rented room at Wawnet Inn for their field-map
Recover the bloodied brass astrolabe outside Fort Nikel

objectives.text: Speak with the bridge-wardens in Weye about the Arcane University survey team's route
Search the scholars' rented room at Wawnet Inn for their field-map
Recover the bloodied brass astrolabe outside Fort Nikel

consequence_detail.summary: Notes wedged inside the astrolabe at Fort Nikel reveal the scholars were lured by invitations to a secret colloquium called the Forest Lectures.

stages.objective: Follow the lantern-ash markers south from Fort Nikel through the oak-glades
Clear the Black Wormgrave-robbers from Fort Virtue and seize their scrip-pouch
Bring the Elder Council scrip tokens back to the University envoy in Weye

objectives.text: Follow the lantern-ash markers south from Fort Nikel through the oak-glades
Clear the Black Worm grave-robbers from Fort Virtue and seize their scrip-pouch
Bring the Elder Council scrip tokens back to the University envoy in Weye

consequence_detail.summary: The grave-robbers at Fort Virtue were paid in Council of Ash scrip to strip Ayleid welkynd conduits across the Great Forest.

stages.objective: Set out from Weye along the southern forest track toward Vlastarus
Free the surviving apprentice held at the Vlastarus waystation
Reconnoitre the necromantic lecture-ring inside Fort Vlastarus

objectives.text: Set out from Weye along the southern forest track toward Vlastarus
Free the surviving apprentice held at the Vlastarus waystation
Reconnoitre the necromantic lecture-ring inside Fort Vlastarus

consequence_detail.summary: The rescued apprentice reveals that Provost-Lich Malakor is binding stolen welkynd stones into soul-engines for the Council of Ash.

stages.objective: Disrupt the midnight convocation at Fort Vlastarus and destroy Provost-Lich Malakor
Shatter the welkynd soul-conduit and recover the abducted scholars' journals
Return the journals and the Council of Ash requisition seal to the University envoy in Weye

consequence_detail.summary: Provost-Lich Malakor's Forest Lectures are ended and the Great Forest's Ayleid conduits are warded by the Arcane University.
